title: i18n: add Spanish translation
body:
### Context

All strings live in `lib/i18n/en.ts`. Wallets pass SEP-24 `lang` to the interactive pages, but only English exists today, so Spanish-speaking users see English.

### Scope

**Files:** `lib/i18n/es.ts (new)`, `lib/i18n/index.tsx`, `zephyr-backend/src/config.ts (SUPPORTED_LANGS, separate PR or note)`

Copy `en.ts` to `es.ts`, translate every value (keep the `{placeholders}`), and register it in `dictionaries`. Type the file as `Messages` so missing keys fail typechecking. Note in the PR that the backend's `SUPPORTED_LANGS` must add `"es"` too.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `?lang=es` renders the interactive pages in Spanish
- [ ] A test checks one translated string
- [ ] A native or fluent speaker reviewed it (mention who)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

title: feat(ui): show a network badge (testnet/public) in the wallet header
body:
### Context

The testnet banner only appears on site pages. Users switching between networks in their wallet need a constant reminder in the header of which network the app targets.

### Scope

**Files:** `app/(site)/layout.tsx`, `lib/i18n/en.ts`, `test/`

Add a small badge next to the logo showing `Testnet` or `Mainnet` from `appConfig.network`, with sufficient contrast in both themes and an accessible name.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Badge visible at 360px without wrapping the nav badly
- [ ] Component test + axe check
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

title: docs: record a short GIF of the escrow withdrawal for the README
body:
### Context

The README has static screenshots (from `scripts/demo-sandbox.mjs`). A short animation of the escrow flow (form → lock → claimed) shows the product's key idea at a glance.

### Scope

**Files:** `README.md`, `docs/images/`, `scripts/demo-sandbox.mjs`

Extend `scripts/demo-sandbox.mjs` to record the escrow flow with Playwright's `recordVideo`, then convert it to an optimised GIF or WebP (< 1 MB) and embed it in the README. Document the conversion command.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] README shows the animation with alt text
- [ ] The recording is reproducible from the script
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

title: feat(ui): copy the transaction id and link to stellar.expert on status pages
body:
### Context

Users contacting support need their transaction id, and power users want to see the Stellar transaction.

### Scope

**Files:** `components/StatusView.tsx`, `lib/i18n/en.ts`, `test/StatusView.test.tsx`

Replace the plain "Reference" text with a `CopyField`. When `stellar_transaction_id` is set, add an external link to `https://stellar.expert/explorer/<network>/tx/<hash>` (`rel="noopener noreferrer"`, and "opens in new tab" announced).

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Both elements are tested
- [ ] Link uses the configured network
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

title: fix(ui): fall back gracefully when the clipboard is blocked
body:
### Context

Some wallet webviews block `navigator.clipboard`. `CopyField` currently fails silently, so users think they copied the bank reference when they didn't.

### Scope

**Files:** `components/CopyField.tsx`, `lib/i18n/en.ts`, `test/StatusView.test.tsx`

When `writeText` is unavailable or rejects, select the value's text (so a long-press copies it) and announce "Copy failed. The text is selected; copy it manually." through the existing live region.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Test covers a rejected and a missing clipboard API
- [ ] The announcement is read by screen readers (aria-live)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

title: feat(wallet): add Hana, Rabet and WalletConnect wallet modules
body:
### Context

The kit supports more wallets than we enable (Freighter, xBull, Lobstr, Albedo). WalletConnect in particular unlocks mobile wallets.

### Scope

**Files:** `lib/wallet.ts`, `.env.example`, `README.md`

Enable the Hana and Rabet modules. Add WalletConnect behind `NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID` (only when set). Check each module's constructor options in the kit's type definitions. Keep the kit lazily loaded (client only).

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The wallet picker lists the new wallets
- [ ] The build still passes without the WalletConnect env var
- [ ] README lists supported wallets
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

title: feat(ui): show the SEP-24 fee breakdown and limits before starting a transfer
body:
### Context

Users only see fees inside the popup. The wallet could fetch `/sep24/info` and preview the fee and limits before they start.

### Scope

**Files:** `components/WalletHome.tsx`, `lib/api/client.ts`, `lib/amount.ts`, `test/`

Fetch `/sep24/info` on load and show min, max and fee for deposit and withdraw. Add an amount field that previews the fee with `quote()`, and pass `amount` to the interactive request so the form is prefilled.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Preview matches the popup's fee exactly (tested with shared cases)
- [ ] Graceful fallback if /info fails
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

title: feat(wallet): standard withdrawal: build and sign the USDC payment with memo
body:
### Context

For standard withdrawals the interactive page tells the user to "return to your wallet" and send USDC with a memo. The reference wallet could do that for them.

### Scope

**Files:** `components/WalletHome.tsx`, `lib/horizon.ts`, `test/`

When a followed withdrawal reaches `pending_user_transfer_start` with `withdraw_anchor_account` and `withdraw_memo`, show a confirmation (amount, destination, memo) and a **Send** button that builds a payment with a text memo, signs it with the kit and submits it. Never send without explicit confirmation.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Exact amount/memo from the anchor; no float math
- [ ] Confirmation step tested
- [ ] Horizon errors shown clearly
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

title: feat(ui): live status updates on the more_info page
body:
### Context

`/sep24/interactive/more-info` polls every 5 s. A progress timeline (submitted → received → paid) would make multi-hour bank transfers less anxious.

### Scope

**Files:** `components/StatusView.tsx`, `components/StatusTimeline.tsx (new)`, `lib/i18n/en.ts`, `test/`

Render an accessible ordered-list timeline of the steps for the transaction's kind and mode (deposit / standard / escrow), marking done, current and upcoming. Don't rely on colour alone (use icons and text), and announce changes politely.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Timeline correct for every SEP-24 status
- [ ] axe + keyboard checks pass
- [ ] Works at 360px
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

title: test(e2e): cover the escrow withdrawal flow with a mocked Soroban RPC
body:
### Context

The Playwright smoke test covers the deposit form. The escrow path (lock → claimed, and refund after expiry) is the riskiest UI and has no end-to-end coverage.

### Scope

**Files:** `e2e/escrow.spec.ts (new)`, `e2e/fixtures/ (new)`

Mock the anchor (`/sep24/*`, `/auth`), Soroban RPC JSON-RPC calls (`simulateTransaction`, `getLatestLedger`, `sendTransaction`, `getTransaction`) and the wallet (inject a fake kit via `page.addInitScript`, or a test-only module). Assert the lock button signs the expected contract call and the refund button appears after the deadline.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Runs offline in CI
- [ ] Asserts the signed XDR invokes `deposit` on the configured contract with the right amount
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

title: perf: lazy-load the Stellar SDK and wallet kit only on wallet pages
body:
### Context

The interactive pages run inside wallet webviews on slow phones. They don't need the Stellar SDK or the wallet kit, but shared imports may pull them into the bundle.

### Scope

**Files:** `lib/`, `app/sep24/interactive/`, `next.config.ts`

Measure the interactive route bundle (`next build` output or `@next/bundle-analyzer`), make sure nothing SDK-related is imported there, and use dynamic imports on wallet pages. Record before/after sizes in the PR.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The interactive route's JS is under 120 KB gzipped (or a documented, justified number)
- [ ] No functional change; tests pass
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

title: feat: SEP-12 KYC screens in the interactive flow
body:
### Context

Once zephyr-backend implements SEP-12, the interactive flow must collect KYC fields (name, address, date of birth, ID document upload) and handle `pending_user`/rejected states.

### Scope

**Files:** `components/KycForm.tsx (new)`, `components/InteractiveFlow.tsx`, `lib/api/`, `lib/i18n/en.ts`, `test/`

Render the fields the backend requests, validate them client-side, upload documents with progress, and show review, rejected and approved states. Follow the backend's OpenAPI once its SEP-12 issue lands; coordinate in that issue.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Fully keyboard- and screen-reader-usable
- [ ] Upload errors handled
- [ ] Component + e2e tests
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

title: feat: installable PWA with an offline shell for the reference wallet
body:
### Context

Mobile users would benefit from installing the wallet and seeing a helpful offline screen instead of a browser error.

### Scope

**Files:** `app/manifest.ts (new)`, `public/ (icons)`, `service worker (new)`, `README.md`

Add a web app manifest and icons, and a service worker that caches the app shell and static assets only (never API responses, tokens or transaction data). Show an offline page, and test installability with Lighthouse.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Lighthouse PWA installable check passes
- [ ] No API/JWT data cached (tested)
- [ ] Service worker update flow documented
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

title: feat(wallet): multisig-aware SEP-10 and escrow signing
body:
### Context

zephyr-backend verifies SEP-10 against an account's signers and threshold, but the wallet only collects one signature. Multisig accounts can't sign in or lock escrow funds.

### Scope

**Files:** `lib/auth.ts`, `lib/escrow.ts`, `components/`, `test/`

Load the account's signers and thresholds from Horizon. If one signature isn't enough, show the partially-signed XDR (copy + QR), let the user paste back or collect more signatures, and submit once the threshold is met. Apply this to SEP-10 and escrow deposit/refund.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] 2-of-3 account signs in (tested with keypairs)
- [ ] Clear UX for collecting signatures
- [ ] No change for single-sig users
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
